executive_summary: Frozen expectation research provenance; no per-cell outcomes or source values.
target: Unchanged LOCATION-01 oracle delta and original V5.1 draw/SD/scale caches
source_universe: All five preregistered SPF current and next-quarter medians, 1998Q1–2024Q4; GDP first actuals1998Q1–2024Q3. No CPI monthly-vs-quarterly surprise invented.
E: Current expectation, next expectation, next-minus-current survey slope, age/21, observed-presence flag. Primary news window 1–21 business days after survey release. This fixed short news window tests new information rather than a persistent macro intercept; chosen before any target score.
V: Current calendar-target expectation minus immediately previous survey expectation for same calendar-target; change5, change21, direction, magnitude. Actual quarterly snapshots only; no interpolated or daily invented snapshots.
D: Excluded: original historical dispersion-publication timing not proven
S: First-release GDP actual minus last matching pre-release current/next-target survey; expanding sample SD of strictly earlier GDP surprises; 24 prior events minimum; S1/S5/S21, summing overlapping eligible original events
cutoff: All publication dates at most preceding business day. Release-day excluded. Mon–Fri business calendar exactly matches inherited pandas BDay semantics.
first_release: Original BEA advance headline; 2018Q4 delayed initial qualifies. No revised values or source latest/recent columns.
missing: Exact zeros for unavailable source features; never synthesize expectation
economic_sign: actual minus expectation; inflation/rates/unemployment E direct numerical sign; no score-dependent flips
interactions: A1:28 global E/S; A2:plus each base feature times horizon5/21/63/126/189; A3:plus groupFX/Rates/FactorEquity; A4:plus 25asset identities; A5:plus25global V columns; D excluded. Metadata appear only multiplied by actual information; no bare intercept.
model: Ridge fit_intercept=False; StandardScaler with_mean=False on active training cells only; alpha selected by active validation delta-MSE, grid0.01/0.1/1/10/100; cold-start100; no CRPS tuning
diagnostic: One HGB on A4, max_depth3/learning_rate0.05/max_iter200/l2_regularization1/random_state19/early_stoppingFalse/categoricalNone; force zero prediction on inactive rows
source_specific: Five independent family-only A4 Ridge fits using the same grid/purge; no source selection; diagnostic full effect assumes shifts only when that family active
purge: Import unchanged LOCATION-01 189BD purge and target maturity; same inherited inner chronological two-year eras

controls.A: Past-only same-family raw-surprise donor sampled with fixedseed1907; frozen genuine past scale, no future donors
controls.B: Same-family independent random signs seed1907; frozen original scaling/activation
controls.C: Immediately older same-target survey. Current value sourced from previous next-target record; missing older next-target and slope encoded0, never fabricated; primary activation window preserved to isolate stale content; older age recorded. Surprise recomputed from strictly older matching snapshot if available.
controls.D: GDP actual event release-date permutation within family/year seed1907; early fictitious dates rejected by max(real_release,permuted_date), conservative delayed activation; never future information. E remains unchanged.
controls.model: Each A–D uses fixed A5 Ridge, same inner grid/purge; controls cannot be selected away
guards: G future source/market mutation leaves features and original cached V5.1 baseline unchanged

scoring: Import common fair CRPS; original per-row normalization scales; clip raw predicted standardized shifts±10 only; import inherited translation geometry guard; no drawn resampling
active: Primary feature-vector nonzero; primary A0–A5/HGB comparison uses identical primary-active masks; controls also report own active coverage and paired metrics on primary-active mask; full means fixed82184 crossfit cells, not135994 training+evaluation ledger
bootstraps: 2000 paired event-date connected-component blocks: origins sharing any survey/GDP event are unioned, transitive overlaps kept together; source publication dates with coincident release unioned; all cells of each origin kept. Full 2000 paired calendar-year blocks seed1903; no cell bootstrap.
control_separation: Primary over each A5-control loss ratio paired event-block upper95% CI <1 and full paired year upper95%CI<1, across A–D; conservative because A/B leave genuine E unchanged
success: At least3active outereras; WEAK active<=.97/full<1/atleast3foldimprovements/capture>.05/clearcontrols; higher gates retain WEAKconditions and YES active<=.95/full<=.995/capture>=.10; STRONG .90/.99/.20; MOONSHOT .80/.98/.35; nonlinear-only separate; no submission
runtime: 15model chunks per fold; each timeout<=900seconds, heartbeat daemon every60seconds, write each prediction/model/audit immediately; scoring by100origins max with incremental checkpoints
